question: Which signed teacher-reference local closure-bias channels inject the persistent mass-neutral reduced-state shape error, under which prescribed-H motion regimes?

model_policy.model: unchanged BC2-C0 enriched prescribed-H reduced model
model_policy.reference_start: exact A2 Reference-projected reduced state at every observation interval

elementary_channels.fixed_internal: q0 through q7 between adjacent 10-cm fixed layers
elementary_channels.q90: q8 between the lowest fixed layer and moving bulk storage
elementary_channels.Gi: moving-boundary geometric transfer theta_i * Hdot, diagnosed exactly from the bulk balance

channel_contributions: qj error transfers -e_qj*dt from upstream compartment and +e_qj*dt to downstream compartment
qi error transfers -e_qi*dt from Wb and +e_qi*dt to Wt
Gi error contributes +e_Gi*dt to Wb and -e_Gi*dt to Wt
exact_ledger_definition.reference_fixed_fluxes: diagnosed recursively from exact Reference fixed-layer storage changes with frozen zero top flux
exact_ledger_definition.teacher_fixed_fluxes: diagnosed recursively from teacher start/end fixed-layer storage changes; q90 is cross-checked against the integrated C0 q90
exact_ledger_definition.hard_identity: sum of all channel storage-contribution vectors must reproduce teacher_end minus Reference_end physical-state error for every interval

diagnostic_families.FIXED_INTERIOR_Q: sum of elementary q0..q7 contribution vectors

metrics_per_elementary_channel_and_famil: cumulative storage-state injection vector over the history
mass-neutral theta-shape norm of cumulative injection at final geometry

route_consistency.rule: All signed and shape-injection diagnostics are computed independently at 0.00005 and 0.000025 day internal dt.
route_consistency.reporting: Absolute primary-minus-cross differences are reported for every aggregate metric.
route_consistency.role: Numerical sensitivity diagnostic only; no route is selected from the result.

interpretation_rules: C3 maps bias injection; it does not test a corrected closure.
A large local flux bias is not automatically a dominant state-shape injector if another channel cancels it conservatively.
qH is the only elementary channel that changes total unsaturated storage directly under identical H(t); internal flux and Gi errors redistribute water and therefore act primarily on shape.
HOLD is retained as an equilibrium/control regime and must not be used to dilute dynamic RISE/FALL/CYCLE conclusions.
No universal signed-bias threshold is introduced. Channel/family rankings are reported per case and route.
next_step_rule: Only after C3 is closed may a separate C4 preregistration select one observed bias family or an explicitly regime-dependent correction hypothesis for a surgical teacher-forced counterfactual. C3 itself authorizes no closure change.
